Kakeibo M2 test report

A hands-on test of the M2 dashboard (savings ring, recent spends, tappable pillar bars, overspend state) on a real phone, plus the automated test suite. Every bug found was fixed and re-checked on the phone before this report was written.

4 November 2026Branch m2-dashboard Debug APKInfinix X6812 · Android 11 · large system font
17checks on the phone
11passed first time
6failed, fixed and re-checked

Bugs found and fixed

KindProblemFixFile
CrashAdding a note crashed the app
The note dialog’s text controller was disposed while the dialog was still animating closed.		The dialog now owns its controller and disposes it after it has gone. A widget test reproduces the crash on the old code and passes on the new.quick_add_sheet.dart
Same causeRemoving an income or fixed-cost row could crash the Plan screen
Found while fixing the crash above: the row’s controllers were disposed before the row left the screen.		They are now disposed after the next frame.plan_month_screen.dart
Wrong valueSavings ring at 0% when slightly overspent
Early in the month one big spend makes the pace projection look huge, which contradicted the caption beside the ring.		Once you are over budget the ring shows how much of the goal is still safe. Unit test added.period_summary.dart
AnnoyanceUndo messages never went away
In this Flutter version a snack bar with an action stays until it is closed.		Undo messages now close after 4 seconds, as the design system says. A newer message replaces an older one.quick_add_sheet.dart, expense_tile.dart
AccessibilityScreen readers could not open a pillar from its bar
The bar’s merged label hid the tap action.		The label now carries the tap action and reads e.g. “Wants, 600 rupees of 22,500 rupees spent, 3 percent”.pillar_bar.dart
Design gapOver-budget bar didn’t say by how much
Missing from the M2 build.		Shows “+Rs 47,500 over” and reads “47,500 rupees over budget”.pillar_bar.dart
PolishPillar name shown twice on spends without a note
Title and caption both used the pillar name.		The caption is left out when it would repeat the title.expense_tile.dart
PolishProjection showed “.00”Whole amounts drop the empty decimals.dashboard_screen.dart

Still open

  • Mood chips partly behind the keypad. On this phone’s large font the third mood chip (Regret) sits under the keypad until you scroll the sheet. In the edit sheet the chips are fully hidden. Planned for the polish pass.
  • Projection with no spending. With nothing spent, the ring caption says you’ll save Rs 110,000 (all income minus fixed costs). That matches the PRD formula, but it reads oddly on day 4. Worth a wording change in M3.
  • Plan amount fields clip long numbers. A 10-digit amount is cut off inside the field while typing. Rare in practice.
  • Your phone has test data. November is planned with test figures (salary Rs 150,000, rent Rs 40,000, goal Rs 20,000) and 4 test spends. Clear it from Android Settings → Apps → Kakeibo → Storage, or edit the plan and delete the spends.

Not covered by this run

  • A full TalkBack run (labels were checked through the accessibility tree instead).
  • Reduced motion, and the largest system font on every screen.
  • Month rollover on the phone. It is covered by unit tests, including 3 skipped months.
  • The “This month I will…” card on the phone. It needs a month-end reflection, which arrives in M3; a widget test covers it.

Automated tests

  • flutter analyze: no issues.
  • flutter test: 50 passed. 8 are new in M2: the projection maths (day 3 cut-off, pace, clamping, overspend), the improvement lookup, the ring and stamp, the overspend message and over-by caption, tapping a pillar bar, and the note-dialog crash.
  • Note-dialog regression test fails on the old code with the same error the phone showed, and passes on the fix.
